method.label: Use the difference of the percentages

annotationRationale: The score equals 30% of all votes, so the decisive calculation finds a total from a known percentage of it.
sourceMethod: Followed the official equation expressing likes and dislikes as 0.65N and 0.35N and setting their difference equal to 90.

review.mathCheck: Dislikes are 35%, so the score is \(0.30N=90\), giving \(N=300\), choice B. The resulting 195 likes and 105 dislikes satisfy both conditions.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 6 (p. 3): subtract the percentage contributions and divide by 0.30. All necessary steps are explained.
review.annotationCheck: The assessed percentage-whole skill captures the decisive calculation. Complement percentages and elementary equation arithmetic are background; no material node is missing.

nativeLayerJudgments.CN: The supplied percentage-whole link exactly matches cnm_p198 and its use here.
nativeLayerJudgments.US: 6.RP.A.3c explicitly covers finding the whole from a part and percentage; 6.RP.A.3 supplies the broader umbrella. This does not assess either standard in full.
nativeLayerJudgments.ailleo: cnm_p198 is appropriate: the solution identifies 90 as 30% of the total and divides to recover that total.
